title: Nourishing Argentinian Coconut Grill
description: Rich and velvety, this Argentinian coconut grill blends coconut cream with allspice and a savory vegetable medley. It is a vegan-friendly comfort dish that feels like a lazy Sunday indulgence.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat, allowing the stones to reach a stable temperature.
In a bowl, combine coconut cream, allspice berries, soy sauce, olive oil, lime juice, salt, and pepper, whisking until fully blended.
Place the sliced tofu, bell pepper, red onion, and zucchini into the bowl, tossing to coat each piece evenly with the coconut mixture.
Let the marinated vegetables and tofu rest for 10 minutes, so the flavors penetrate.
Arrange the marinated slices on the grill, ensuring they are spaced so steam can circulate.
Grill the tofu and vegetables for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, or until grill marks appear and the edges are slightly charred.
While grilling, flip the pieces gently with tongs, and sprinkle a few crushed allspice berries over the tops.
When the tofu is cooked through and the vegetables are tender yet still crisp, transfer the whole plate to a serving platter.
Drizzle any remaining coconut mixture from the bowl over the grilled items for a glossy finish.
Garnish with a squeeze of fresh lime and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro, then serve hot.
